name: codegraph_context
description: PRIMARY TOOL — call FIRST for any "how does X work"/architecture/bug question. Returns entry points + related symbols + key code in one call; usually answers without further search/Read/Grep. Provides CODE context, not product requirements.

task.description: Description of the task, bug, or feature to build context for

includeCode.description: Include code snippets for key symbols (default: true)

projectPath.description: Path to a different project with .codegraph/ initialized. If omitted, uses current project. Use this to query other codebases.
